420:t_020:5.en:
$n
「$$ランド$$! You got hurt for my sake...」

420:t_020:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「But you're safe, aren't you, $$メール$$?」

420:t_020:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「The worst pain for me isn't the unease deep in my chest, or the wounds on my body. It's seeing you get hurt.」

420:t_020:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「Every man endures... And even more so a grown-up with responsibilities.」

420:t_020:13.en:
$$メール$$
「...You too, Darling? Is there something you've been putting up with all this time, too, Darling?」

420:t_020:14.en:
$$ランド$$
「It's pathetic, but... ever since we were fighting on $$翠の地球$$, I've been carrying this unease.」

420:t_020:16.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't really know what it is... But the thought that someday... the world might end, never left my head...」

420:t_020:17.en:
$n
「So $$ランド$$ has been feeling the same unease I have...」

420:t_020:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「These are the times we live in. Everyone endures pain.」

420:t_021:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「But, $$メール$$... As long as you keep smiling, I can endure any pain!」

420:t_021:2.en:
$$桂$$
「You'll finish this for us, won't you, $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

420:t_021:3.en:
$n
「That smile... I knew it. $$ランド$$ is my Master... $$ザ・ヒート$$!」

420:t_021:11.en:
$$ランド$$
「You wouldn't understand, $$ストラウス$$, $$バルビエル$$! What it means to live with everything you've got, sweating for it!」

420:t_021:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「$n repeats punches and kicks from morning till night, and $$レド$$ struggles with machinery he's never worked on! All to stay alive!」

420:t_021:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「I can't lose to bastards who'd blow that kind of life away with a single missile!!」

420:t_022:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「That last one hurt, $$ストラウス$$! After $n, it's my turn to show you I'm serious!」

420:t_022:1.en:
$$メール$$
「Go get 'em, Darling! $$ガンレオン$$!!」

420:t_022:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Roar, $$ガンレオン$$! We're going all out!!」

420:t_024:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All right! That's my man, The Crusher!」

420:t_024:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「W-what is this? My body's getting hot...!」

420:t_024:5.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The power of a life that endures pain... He's wonderful.」

420:t_024:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「What is this...? Just watching that guy makes strength well up in me...」

420:t_024:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「It's not my imagination or just the mood...! This... is real power!」

420:t_024:8.en:
$$桂$$
「This feeling...! The direction is different, but it's the same as the power $$ガドライト#pilot$$ gave off!」

420:t_024:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ランド$$ and $$ガンレオン$$ have also awakened to the power of the $$スフィア$$... to $$スフィア・アクト$$.」

420:t_024:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「How do you like that, $$ストラウス$$!!」

420:t_024:13.en:
$$ストラウス$$
「Aha... The armor got busted, huh.」

420:t_025:0.en:
$$ストラウス$$
「In that case... I don't need this thing anymore!」

420:t_026:0.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Here's my payback, Darling!」

420:t_027:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahahaha! Just what I'd expect from you, Darling! You can even take this attack!」

420:t_027:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Me? I'm $$ストラウス$$.」

420:t_027:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「My full name is $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$. I'm the leader of $$ハイアデス$$, the strongest fighting group in the galaxy, and the Supreme Commander of the $$新地球皇国$$ forces.」

420:t_028:0.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$!」

420:t_028:1.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「You made it, $$ダバラーン$$.」

420:t_028:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「O-oh... That form of yours...!」

420:t_028:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Darling is seriously amazing, you know. My armor got wrecked.」

420:t_028:4.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I'll apologize to $$アウストラリス$$ myself, so don't worry about it, $$ダバラーン$$.」

420:t_028:5.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Yes, ma'am! For my part, it is an utmost honor to see Supreme Commander $$ストラウス$$ like this after so long!」

420:t_028:6.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「So stiff... Just call me Lady $$エルーナ$$ like you used to.」

420:t_028:7.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Then I shall do as you say!」

420:t_029:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「So that's what $$ストラウス$$ really is...!?」

420:t_029:1.en:
$$桂$$
「No way! It's not a buffalo, it's a Holstein!?」

420:t_029:3.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Ahaha, did I surprise you? Maybe $$アウストラリス$$ was right, and armor really is necessary after all.」

420:t_029:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What is the meaning of this, $$ストラウス$$!」

420:t_029:5.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Call me $$エルーナルーナ$$. Daddy went to the trouble of giving me a nice name, and $$ストラウス$$ is so bland.」

420:t_029:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Who on earth is that!?」

420:t_029:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「So that's the Supreme Commander of the Empire's forces that wiped out the $$地球連邦軍$$...」

420:t_029:8.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「I mean, as the head of an organization like an army, you do need a certain dignity and presence. I agreed to wear the armor myself.」

420:t_029:9.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「But the Earth has as good as fallen already. From here on, I'll do things my way.」

420:t_029:11.en:
$$エルーナルーナ$$
「Isn't it obvious? A battle that gets the blood pumping.」
